controller_loop.semantic_check_limit: Exact quotes, hashes and coverage are deterministic checks; entailment requires source-grounded extraction or targeted semantic review and remains subject to evaluation.
controller_loop.unknown_request_completion: Keep reservation, operation ID and unknown usage; do not promise exactly-once execution across APIs.

mode_policy.entry: 已发布索引的范围、身份、时间和证据包足够

mode_policy.entry: 已定位事件/阶段，但关键事实缺引用、冲突或边界待核
mode_policy.cost_rule: Read the smallest supporting spans plus relevant context, cache the evidence.

mode_policy.entry: 缺失事件链、完整统计覆盖不足、多轮证据冲突或原文定位连续失败
mode_policy.cost_rule: Never increase the authorized total budget automatically. Save progress on exhaustion.

cross_record_checks: source span end_char > start_char and exact substring/hash match

counterfactual answers and reader opinions are not published as book facts
